prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. This crate tests primality and lists primes. `is_prime(n)` must be false for 0 and 1, true for 2 and 3, and must not treat the square of a prime as prime. `primes_up_to(n)` returns every prime in `2..=n` in ascending order, and an empty vector when `n < 2`. Keep the public signatures and the existing tests unchanged. Inspect the code, make the smallest correct change, run `cargo test`, and finish only when the tests pass.
